INSERT INTO tbl_job ( job_id, source, source_job_id, title, org_name, inst_cd, ncs_cd, ncs_nm, hire_type_cd, hire_type_nm, work_rgn_cd, work_rgn_nm, recrut_se, recrut_se_nm, acbg_cond_cd, acbg_cond_nm, hire_cnt, subst_yn, start_date, end_date, url, fetched_at ) VALUES ( #{jobId}, #{source}, #{sourceJobId}, #{title}, #{orgName}, #{instCd}, #{ncsCd}, #{ncsNm}, #{hireTypeCd}, #{hireTypeNm}, #{workRgnCd}, #{workRgnNm}, #{recrutSe}, #{recrutSeNm}, #{acbgCondCd}, #{acbgCondNm}, #{hireCnt}, #{substYn}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{url}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_job SET title = #{title}, org_name = #{orgName}, inst_cd = #{instCd}, ncs_cd = #{ncsCd}, ncs_nm = #{ncsNm}, hire_type_cd = #{hireTypeCd}, hire_type_nm = #{hireTypeNm}, work_rgn_cd = #{workRgnCd}, work_rgn_nm = #{workRgnNm}, recrut_se = #{recrutSe}, recrut_se_nm = #{recrutSeNm}, acbg_cond_cd = #{acbgCondCd}, acbg_cond_nm = #{acbgCondNm}, hire_cnt = #{hireCnt}, subst_yn = #{substYn}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, url = #{url}, fetched_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
UPDATE tbl_job SET qualify_cn = #{qualifyCn}, pref_cn = #{prefCn}, procedure_cn = #{procedureCn}, detail_fetched = 'Y' WHERE job_id = #{jobId}

MERGE INTO tbl_job t USING (SELECT #{source} AS source, #{sourceJobId} AS source_job_id FROM DUAL) s ON (t.source = s.source AND t.source_job_id = s.source_job_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET title = #{title}, org_name = #{orgName}, inst_cd = #{instCd}, ncs_cd = #{ncsCd}, ncs_nm = #{ncsNm}, hire_type_cd = #{hireTypeCd}, hire_type_nm = #{hireTypeNm}, work_rgn_cd = #{workRgnCd}, work_rgn_nm = #{workRgnNm}, recrut_se = #{recrutSe}, recrut_se_nm = #{recrutSeNm}, acbg_cond_cd = #{acbgCondCd}, acbg_cond_nm = #{acbgCondNm}, hire_cnt = #{hireCnt}, subst_yn = #{substYn}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, url = #{url}, fetched_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (job_id, source, source_job_id, title, org_name, inst_cd, ncs_cd, ncs_nm, hire_type_cd, hire_type_nm, work_rgn_cd, work_rgn_nm, recrut_se, recrut_se_nm, acbg_cond_cd, acbg_cond_nm, hire_cnt, subst_yn, start_date, end_date, url, fetched_at) VALUES (seq_tbl_job.NEXTVAL, #{source}, #{sourceJobId}, #{title}, #{orgName}, #{instCd}, #{ncsCd}, #{ncsNm}, #{hireTypeCd}, #{hireTypeNm}, #{workRgnCd}, #{workRgnNm}, #{recrutSe}, #{recrutSeNm}, #{acbgCondCd}, #{acbgCondNm}, #{hireCnt}, #{substYn}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{url}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
